description: React component for the left panel of the 'Add Dataset' feature in Apache Superset, including styling, state management, and UI interactions for selecting databases, schemas, and tables.

methods.name: setDatabase
methods.description: Sets the selected database in the dataset state.

methods.name: setCatalog
methods.description: Sets the selected catalog in the dataset state.

methods.name: setSchema
methods.description: Sets the selected schema in the dataset state.

methods.name: setTable
methods.description: Sets the selected table in the dataset state.

methods.name: getDatabaseEmptyState
methods.description: Returns the empty state UI when no databases are available or match search.
